CHAR1 is Vex. Preserve exact facial identity, makeup, hairstyle, body proportions, horns, perfect smooth emerald skin, thin agile tail. Vex is wearing tiny tight worn-out suede lederhosen, a worn brown suede bib-belt across her chest with two silver ring-buckles and shoulder straps, brown lace-up boots, forearm wraps, She looks happy.
CAMERA: medium-wide. Vex left, hip against a desk. A tall glowing rectangular panel fills the right half of the frame.
LOCATION: Dim workshop. One battered desk. Cream parchment comic light. 
The glowing panel is the Settings page. Title at the top reads Settings. The panel is split into two stacked sections. Upper section labeled Style examples. Lower section labeled Model and LoRAs. Readable short labels only. No gibberish.
ACTION: Vex points at the words Style examples.
GAZE: Vex looks at the Style examples label, happy smirking, not at the viewer.
